segments.sn21.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn21.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu theranāmako ekavihārī ceva hoti ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī.
segments.sn21.10:1.3: So eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati eko paṭikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
segments.sn21.10:1.4: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn21.10:1.5: “idha, bhante, aññataro bhikkhu theranāmako ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti.
segments.sn21.10:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn21.10:2.2: “ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mama vacanena theraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi –
segments.sn21.10:2.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā thero tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn21.10:2.6: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā thero tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ theraṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn21.10:2.7: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, thera, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti?
segments.sn21.10:2.9: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, thera, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti?
segments.sn21.10:2.10: “Idhāhaṃ, bhante, eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisāmi eko paṭikkamāmi eko raho nisīdāmi eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāmi.
segments.sn21.10:2.11: Evaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti.
segments.sn21.10:3.2: Api ca, thera, yathā ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi;
segments.sn21.10:3.6: Idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.
segments.sn21.10:3.7: Evaṃ kho, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hotī”ti.
segments.sn21.10:4.2: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –

lines: Yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnanti atīte khandhapañcake chandarāgappahānena taṃ pahīnaṃ nāma hoti.
Anāgatanti anāgatampi khandhapañcakaṃ tattha chandarāgapaṭinissaggena paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ nāma hoti.
Sabbābhibhunti sabbā khandhāyatanadhātuyo ca tayo bhave ca abhibhavitvā ṭhitaṃ.
Sabbavidunti taṃ vuttappakāraṃ sabbaṃ viditaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā ṭhitaṃ.
Sabbañjahanti tadeva sabbaṃ tattha chandarāgappahānena jahitvā ṭhitaṃ.
Taṇhakkhaye vimuttanti taṇhakkhayasaṅkhāte nibbāne tadārammaṇāya vimuttiyā vimuttaṃ.
Sabbā khandhāyatanadhātuyo cāti iminā upādiṇṇānampi anupādiṇṇānampi dvidhā pavattalokiyadhammānaṃ gahaṇaṃ avisesetvā vuttattā.
Tadeva sabbanti heṭṭhā tīsupi padesu idha sabbaggahaṇena gahitaṃ tebhūmakavaṭṭaṃ.
Tamahanti taṃ uttamapuggalaṃ ekavihāriṃ brūmi taṇhādutiyassa abhāvato.
Ettha ca pariññāpahānābhisamayakathanena itarampi abhisamayaṃ atthato kathitamevāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
